description.value: Barb's Bakery & Bistro is a neighbourhood bakery and café in Ganges on Salt Spring Island, baking pastries, breads, muffins, croissants, and seasonal treats fresh daily. The menu also features a full specialty coffee program, house-blend smoothies named after local landmarks, and a curated selection of Silk Road loose-leaf teas. It would make a solid fuelling stop for cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island's roads.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 30m; rack at 44m; rack at 63m; rack at 63m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business address as #1 - 121 McPhillips Avenue, Ganges, BC (Salt Spring Island), which aligns with the OSM coordinates (48.85°N, 123.50°W) but contradicts the OSM community field of 'Duncan.' Takeout is explicitly confirmed by the website phrase 'take-out and pick-ups.' No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field is 'Duncan' but the website and coordinates both place the business in Ganges, Salt Spring Island (V8K 2T6) — the OSM community tag appears incorrect.
OSM carries no phone or address; both fields are sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed for phone and address cannot be cross-checked against OSM.

Website copyright reads '© Barb's Bakery & Bistro 2015' and all blog posts are from late 2015, suggesting the site may not be actively maintained; however, the menu and online ordering system appear current and looks_closed is false.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A functioning bakery and café in Ganges on Salt Spring Island — a popular cycling destination — with confirmed takeout service; a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Monday - Friday 7am - 3pm for take-out and pick-ups' and includes an online ordering system

wow_evidence: neighbourhood bakery and café in Ganges on Salt Spring Island
